question: Find the full names and phone numbers of members who both (1) attended an event that was budgeted for food and (2) have at least one expense costing more than the average cost of all expenses in the 'Food' category.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036, m.XCL_040
FROM member AS m
WHERE m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM attendance AS a
    INNER JOIN event AS e ON a.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
    INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
    WHERE b.XCL_004 = 'Food'
)
AND m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT e2.XCL_022
    FROM expense AS e2
    INNER JOIN budget AS b2 ON e2.XCL_023 = b2.XCL_003
    WHERE b2.XCL_004 = 'Food'
      AND e2.XCL_020 > (
          SELECT AVG(e3.XCL_020)
          FROM expense AS e3
          INNER JOIN budget AS b3 ON e3.XCL_023 = b3.XCL_003
          WHERE b3.XCL_004 = 'Food'
      )
)

SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036, m.XCL_040
FROM member AS m
WHERE m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM attendance AS a
    INNER JOIN event AS e ON a.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
    INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
    WHERE b.XCL_004 = 'Food'
)
AND m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT e2.XCL_022
    FROM expense AS e2
    INNER JOIN budget AS b2 ON e2.XCL_023 = b2.XCL_003
    WHERE b2.XCL_004 = 'Food'
      AND e2.XCL_020 > (
          SELECT AVG(e3.XCL_020)
          FROM expense AS e3
          INNER JOIN budget AS b3 ON e3.XCL_023 = b3.XCL_003
          WHERE b3.XCL_004 = 'Food'
      )
)

SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_035 || ' ' || m.XCL_036 AS full_name, m.XCL_040 AS phone_number
FROM member m
INNER JOIN attendance a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
INNER JOIN event e ON a.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
INNER JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
WHERE b.XCL_004 = 'Food'
AND m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT e2.XCL_022
    FROM expense e2
    WHERE e2.XCL_018 = 'Food'
    AND e2.XCL_020 > (
        SELECT AVG(e3.XCL_020)
        FROM expense e3
        WHERE e3.XCL_018 = 'Food'
    )
)
